overviewParagraphs: Located just a short 20-minute drive from the center of Chiang Mai, Mae Jo Golf Club is widely considered one of the most picturesque and enjoyable courses in Northern Thailand. Designed by local Thai architect Seni Thirawat, the layout fits seamlessly into its natural surroundings.

The course is beautifully routed through mature fruit orchards featuring mango, pomelo, and lychee trees, which provide both a visual feast and strategic obstacles. The defining characteristic of Mae Jo is the breathtaking views of the iconic Doi Suthep temple and the surrounding mountain ranges, which are visible from nearly every hole.

While relatively short at 6,730 yards from the back tees, Mae Jo is a thinking player's course. It demands precision off the tee and careful distance control on approaches to the firm, undulating Korean Velvet greens. It's an idyllic addition to any Chiang Mai golf itinerary.

curatorBriefHtml: Mae Jo Golf Resort & Spa (opened 2004 by Seni Thirawat just 25 minutes north of Chiang Mai’s Old City) is Northern Thailand’s most charming, authentic orchard-lined parkland layout. Playing 6,730 yards (Par 72) amidst thousands of fragrant lychee, mango, pomelo, and longan fruit trees beneath the towering Doi Suthep mountain ridge, Mae Jo delivers serene rural scenery and genuine Lanna hospitality.

Having played Mae Jo personally, its appeal is effortless playability and scenic rhythm — wide Zoysia fairways invite relaxed driving, mountain views frame almost every green, and its close proximity to town means you are back in Chiang Mai in time for an afternoon spa or riverside lunch.
Mae Jo rounds out the classic Northern Thailand trio on our Lanna Heritage Golf Trail alongside Chiang Mai Highlands and Alpine Chiang Mai.

scorecard.verdict: Surrounded by Longan and Lychee fruit orchards, Mae Jo offers a scenic, tranquil test with steep doglegs and contoured greens that reward strategic club choices.

faqs.q: What makes Mae Jo Golf Resort unique in Chiang Mai?
faqs.a: Routed through lush working fruit orchards (mango, lychee, longan, and pomelo) with Doi Suthep mountain backdrops, Mae Jo offers relaxed, authentic Northern Thai parkland charm just 25 minutes from the Old City.

faqs.q: How does Mae Jo compare to Chiang Mai Highlands and Alpine?
faqs.a: Mae Jo is flatter, closer to central Chiang Mai, and gentler on mid-to-high handicaps — making it the ideal opening warm-up round before tackling Chiang Mai Highlands and Alpine.

faqs.q: How far is Mae Jo Golf Resort from central Chiang Mai?
faqs.a: Just 25 to 30 minutes north of Chiang Mai Old City and Chiang Mai International Airport (CNX).

faqs.q: When is the best season to play Mae Jo?
faqs.a: November through February brings cool, dry Northern Thailand mornings (16–26°C) and clear views of Doi Suthep.
